description: An outside tool registered on this site, which course lessons can open with LTI 1.3. The tool's administrator gives you its login and launch URLs and its key-set URL; you give them the client ID, deployment ID and this site's endpoints shown on the form.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown to instructors when they choose a tool.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: Generated by this site. Give it to the tool.

fields.label: Deployment ID
fields.description: Generated by this site. Give it to the tool.

fields.label: Login URL
fields.description: Where a launch starts (the tool's OpenID Connect login initiation URL).

fields.label: Launch URL
fields.description: Where a launch lands when a lesson names no URL of its own.

fields.label: Content selection URL
fields.description: Where instructors choose content inside the tool (Deep Linking). Leave empty if the tool has none.

fields.label: Redirect URLs
fields.description: One per line. Launches may only be sent to these. Empty means the launch and content selection URLs.

fields.label: Public key
fields.description: A PEM public key, for a tool that has no key-set URL.

fields.label: Content selection
fields.description: Instructors may add content from the tool to a chapter.

fields.label: Class list
fields.description: The tool may read the section's members and their roles.

fields.label: Grades
fields.description: The tool may read its line items and post scores.

fields.label: Send name
fields.description: Send each person's name to the tool, at launch and in the class list.

fields.label: Send email
fields.description: Send each person's email to the tool, at launch and in the class list.

fields.label: Open in
fields.description: Embedded works only if the tool allows being framed.

fields.label: Custom parameters
fields.description: Sent with every launch, one key=value per line.

name: LTI Tool
